people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
translations.bsb: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim.
